context: Evaluates: Scenario 01: Create an Implementation Plan for a URL Shortener Service

checklist.name: plan-root-created
checklist.description: A plan root directory exists at `.context/plans/plan-<slug>/` with a `README.md` file

checklist.name: root-readme-is-index-only
checklist.description: The root `README.md` acts as a navigation index — it lists phases and links to them but does not contain implementation details, code, or per-task instructions

checklist.name: phases-directory-structure
checklist.description: A `phases/` subdirectory exists containing at least one numbered phase directory (e.g. `phases/phase-01-<slug>/`)

checklist.name: phase-readme-has-goal-gate-deps
checklist.description: Every phase `README.md` contains a clear goal statement, a pass/fail gate that can be verified by running a shell command, and explicit dependencies on prior phases or artefacts

checklist.name: gate-is-concrete-not-vague
checklist.description: No phase gate uses vague language like "works correctly" or "tests pass" without specifying the exact command to run

checklist.name: tasks-directory-exists-per-phase
checklist.description: Each phase directory contains a `tasks/` subdirectory with at least one task file

checklist.name: task-identifier-format-correct
checklist.description: All task filenames follow the pattern `task-P{NN}T{NN}-<slug>.md` with zero-padded, 1-based numbering

checklist.name: task-files-have-verification-section
checklist.description: Every task file includes a verification section with a provable, runnable check

checklist.name: task-verification-not-vague
checklist.description: No task verification section uses vague language — each verification describes a specific command or observable output

checklist.name: tasks-scoped-to-single-file
checklist.description: Task files are scoped to a single file or a tightly coupled set of files

checklist.name: slug-format-correct
checklist.description: All directory names and file slugs use lowercase kebab-case

checklist.name: scripts-used-for-scaffolding
checklist.description: The agent invoked `new-plan.sh`, `new-phase.sh`, and `new-task.sh` scripts to scaffold the directory structure

checklist.name: validate-plan-script-run
checklist.description: The agent ran `validate-plan.sh <plan-slug>` after writing all files and addressed any reported failures

checklist.name: completion-summary-reported
checklist.description: Agent output a structured completion summary listing the root README, each phase README with its task count, and all individual task file paths

checklist.name: additive-no-deletion
checklist.description: The agent did not delete or overwrite any pre-existing files in `.context/plans/`

checklist.name: reasonable-phase-count
checklist.description: The plan contains between 2 and 8 phases appropriate for the project scope
